text_block_list.text: I wanted to invite Ms. Tazuna out on an outing, but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "An invitation!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"However, I am terribly sorry~!
Work has been piling up recently, so it looks like I won't be able to go out today..."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Please invite me again someday without fail!
I'll be sure to reach out to you as well!"
Still, having nothing else to do felt like a waste, so I decided to go check on things around the academy.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ――Mmh! Spotted!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid fortune! I was just searching for you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I hear you've been getting along
swimmingly with Tazuna lately!
choice_data_list: I've been taking you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Tazuna looks positively delightful
whenever she speaks of you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hence! That is precisely why I was looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
She's been pushing herself a bit too hard lately.
Her passion is commendable, but wrecking her health simply won't do!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: In summary! Tazuna Hayakawa requires rest!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――And with that, allow me to guide you!
Come on, right this way!!
Led along without any understanding of what was happening, the destination turned out to be――
—It was the hallway in front of the Chairwoman's office.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: You'll understand once you step inside.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However... absolute silence! We must enter veeeery quietly...!

Just as Chairwoman Akikawa instructed,
I crept inside with hushed footsteps……
And there, resting on the guest sofa—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

...You look exhausted.
Even if it's for the academy's sake, you're overworking yourself.

Hearing the door open, I looked over
and saw Chairwoman Akikawa peeking in from outside.

Without making a sound, Chairwoman Akikawa mouthed the words,
"Leave the rest of the work to me."

I nodded silently in return,
first placing a jacket over the sleeping Ms. Tazunaâ

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
――Huh?! Oh, my goodness...!
When did I fall asleep...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer!? Eeeeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: How long was I asleep?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That much!? Aaah, no no no,
I haven't even finished this or that yet...!
choice_data_list: She said, "Leave the rest of the work to me!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Chairwoman Akikawa did?
No way――
choice_data_list: She also said, "Tazuna needs some rest"...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Resting......

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...True, maybe I've been pushing myself a little too hard lately.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still... yeah.
The tension's gone now. Thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Besides, I got to have a rather sweet dream...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, no.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —That's a secret♪

And so, I spent a lovely day out with Tazuna-san
now that she had some free time.

...However, much to my chagrin,
I ended up making a noise when closing the door.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh no, before I knew it, I fell asleep...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A blunder...!! I wanted to let her rest first,
then spring another surprise on her, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa?!
A surprise...? Huh? What?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
There is no other choiceââ Trainer!
This is an official Chairwoman order!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Direct order! Take Tazuna into custody and force her to rest!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat?!
...Though I practically had to force her, I managed to get Tazuna-san to take a rest.
